## Hal Williams

“Sanford and Son” star and veteran actor Hal Williams died inside his California home on July 15. There’s been no word yet on the official cause of his death. Williams, known for roles in shows like “Private Benjamin,” “The Waltons,” and most notably “227,” starring opposite Marla Gibbs, is survived by his three children. He was 91.
